2610.13806.title: FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems
2610.13806.paper_summary: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. To account for interactions, it evaluates candidate feature sets constructed from all the low-rank features through grouped ablation and its offline results are sufficiently predictive of online A/B tests to allow deprecations to proceed to online testing with confidence. Lineage tracing identifies all downstream consumer models to realize the full savings of removing a feature from the training set. We validate FORTE over 2 large-scale recommender systems and find that it identifies deprecable feature sets which do not cause online regressions, while the impact on efficiency depends on model characteristics. On a search-relevance model, FORTE resulted in 3 nested candidate sets of 32, 48, and 59 features. Online guardrails rejected the largest treatment. The 48-feature set was selected for deprecation, removing 43.3% of the model's features. On a large ranking model, FORTE identified 8 candidates for removal. Retraining and A/B testing confirmed no regression. Its launch reduced the trainable parameters by 29.9%, improved serving throughput by 19.8-25.5%, and reduced annual training costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars.
2610.13806.paper_summary_zh: 生產推薦系統具有特徵生命週期的不對稱性：新增特徵必須在某些指標上產生增益，而移除特徵則不得使任何指標回退。實際上，特徵的棄用很難優先考慮，因為如果特徵與其他特徵互動，它可能無法被移除；其重要性每天都在變化；在生產模型變更或數據漂移發生之前無法進行評估；它與其他發佈在A/B測試空間中存在競爭；它在在線A/B測試中導致回退；或者它被多個模型使用，這些模型需要協調其棄用。我們提出了FORTE，一個與模型無關的生產框架，用於發現、驗證和移除特徵。其高效的擾動實現允許每日特徵評估。為了考慮互動，它評估從所有低秩特徵構建的候選特徵集，通過分組消融，其離線結果對在線A/B測試具有足夠的預測能力，使得棄用能夠自信地進入在線測試。血統追蹤識別所有下游消費模型，以實現從訓練集移除特徵的全部節省。我們在兩個大型推薦系統上驗證了FORTE，發現它識別出可棄用的特徵集，這些特徵集不會導致在線回退，而對效率的影響取決於模型特徵。在一個搜索相關性模型中，FORTE產生了3個嵌套的候選集，包含32、48和59個特徵。在線防護措施拒絕了最大的處理。選擇了48特徵集進行棄用，移除了43.3%的模型特徵。在一個大型排名模型中，FORTE識別了8個待移除的候選者。重新訓練和A/B測試確認沒有回退。其推出使可訓練參數減少了29.9%，服務吞吐量提高了19.8-25.5%，並將年度訓練成本減少了數十萬美元。
